April 2022 Customer Data

Moving from Next-Best-Action to Next-Best-Dollar

As Heraclitus reminds us, "No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it's not the same river and he's not the same man." This is arguably even more true given the rapid changes we've seen in business lately. The global pandemic humbled retailers slow to adopt digital, as digital-only interactions grew to 72% in a short period.

Amid rapid change, marketing always seems to lead the way. When the CEO picks up the bat phone, he's calling the CMO first. What does the agile marketing organization require? It starts with data, intelligence, and automation...

March 2022 CDP Strategy

Data Gravity: Why Better Data Beats More Data

Ben Bloom's recent post on the Gartner Blog shined a light on a topic we rarely hear about in the CDP world — the cost and effort associated with building a first-party data asset, and the possibly diminishing returns of building a complex "Customer 360" view.

In the CDP boom we're living in, many brands are caught up in the notion that more data is better, and not considering that better data (and less of it) may be more impactful. The concept of "data gravity" — when the more data you have, the more you attract — offers a useful lens...
